statusDetail: Coverage-complete multi-template audit; no local source or fixes requested.

page.notes: Public Russian weather, news, and maps site. Audited four distinct templates plus 404. Not covered: authenticated profile/OAuth completion, advertising click-through destinations, every city/date variant, or private account settings.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshot remains the same light grey/white palette as the normal capture; no site dark theme is applied.

checkOutcomes.method: evaluate reduced-motion media query and getAnimations()
checkOutcomes.evidence: Reduced-motion probe reported zero active animations under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Forced-colors/high-contrast screenshot preserved text, controls, boundaries, and consent actions.
DOM/script inspection found no authored view-transition CSS or transition setup across the MPA links, while representative navigation is cross-document.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The DOM and screenshots show descriptive forecast-period links, active contextual page labels, and clear map playback state.
Load screenshots show a modal dimming and obscuring the entire forecast/article/map before interaction; on mobile its rejection action is off-screen.
DOM inventory shows the consent overlay implemented as DIV role=dialog rather than a native dialog, and mobile dismissal remains broken.
Homepage screenshot is crowded by news modules, advertising and modal chrome around a compact weather card.
Mobile screenshots on all four representative templates show a fixed 512px consent dialog beginning at x=249; its text and action buttons extend beyond the right viewport edge and cannot be reached.
The CSS probe over loaded stylesheets found no @container rules; the fixed-width consent component overflows narrow reuse conditions.
The focus probe focused the Новости link but computed outline-style was none; many primary links were only 20px high and forecast tabs 40px high, below a comfortable 44px target.
Titles, H1 content, weather cards, forecast-period links, and map controls clearly communicate each page purpose once visible.
The homepage, weather detail, news article, and map journey all stop at the same horizontally clipped consent state at 360x800.
The 360x800 404 screenshot clips the recovery sentence and link off the right edge, although the DOM contains a home link.
Lighthouse measured LCP of 10.8s home, 16.2s weather, 12.2s news, and 12.7s maps; trace LCP was 9.12s.
Lighthouse CLS remained 0–0.018 across four templates, within the good range.
Lighthouse reported 5.6s main-thread work and 3.4s JS execution on home, 11.2s and 6.2s on weather.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary and Lighthouse delivery diagnostics
checkOutcomes.evidence: HAR recorded 146 requests/2.71MB and Lighthouse estimated 896KiB cache-lifetime savings on home.
HAR recorded 2.71MB across 146 requests, 2.22MB of script, with 143 requests and 2.65MB classified third-party; Lighthouse estimated 1,624KiB unused JS on home and 1,612KiB on weather.
Lighthouse found 21/16/11/15 required-parent ARIA failures across the templates and five unnamed buttons on maps.
Lighthouse found 34 contrast failures on home, 32 weather, 19 news, and 39 maps.
Lighthouse ARIA ownership failures and the focus probe with outline-style none show structure/focus divergence.
Article/body text is readable at mobile scale, but clipping is isolated to the reported consent and 404 layout defects.

checkOutcomes.method: viewport metadata, mobile screenshots, target-size probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Viewport permits maximum-scale=5, but the 360px screenshots and target probe show clipped dialog/recovery content and sub-44px targets.
Lighthouse did not report the errors-in-console audit as failing on any of four templates.
The page has UTF-8, a viewport meta and modern WebP map images; the one missing image dimension is reported through delivery/sustainability evidence.
Every Lighthouse run found a deprecated API warning, five BFCache failure reasons, and DevTools inspector issues.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM metadata probe plus Lighthouse SEO
checkOutcomes.evidence: DOM probe found a descriptive title and meta description; Lighthouse SEO was 100 on all templates.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM links/viewport, browser fetch robots, Lighthouse SEO
checkOutcomes.evidence: Real href links and viewport meta were present; robots.txt returned 200 and Lighthouse SEO scored 100.
Homepage returned 200 with canonical URL, ru/ru-BY/ru-KZ hreflang, indexable robots policy, and a current sitemap index.
Metadata probe found useful Open Graph tags and hreflang, but no JSON-LD on the weather homepage despite representing places and forecasts.
Headers evidence found no CSP, frame protection, or Permissions-Policy. Cookie evidence found eight cookies flagged insecure; FCCDCF is non-Secure, SameSite=None, and 390 days.
Tracker capture saw 23 third-party origins; HAR attributed 143 of 146 requests and 2.65MB to third parties, including DoubleClick and Yandex analytics/ad traffic.

checkOutcomes.method: load observation and DOM link/form inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: No permission prompt appeared on load; public authentication entry points use VK ID and Yandex ID OAuth rather than an authored password form.
HSTS and Referrer-Policy are present, but CSP/frame protection and Permissions-Policy are absent.
Discoverability capture found 75% raw-HTML coverage, no JS shell, and visible weather content in the crawler screenshot.
Forecast/navigation content renders server-side and representative templates expose stable native links; no cut-off authored menu was observed apart from the separately reported consent component.
The site links a web app manifest, but navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations() returned no registrations.
Invalid URL returns a clear Russian 404 message and home link, but its mobile recovery layout is clipped.
The document declares lang=ru and exposes ru, ru-BY, and ru-KZ hreflang variants; Russian reading order renders correctly.
Dates, weekdays, units, decimal conventions, and forecast labels render in Russian on both domestic and international-location content.
Weather pages are keyed to a named location and display local date/time context rather than an ambiguous global timestamp.
Desktop consent presents equally prominent Отказаться and Согласиться actions; the mobile layout failure is reported separately as usability, not deceptive intent.

checkOutcomes.method: baseline/post heap-summary comparison after 10 repeated attempts
checkOutcomes.evidence: After repeated consent settings attempts, heap self size rose 2.7% and node count 1.5%; this bounded delta does not establish unbounded retained growth.
The weather-detail baseline heap summary contained 938,696 nodes and 49,952,936 bytes self size before a representative interaction.
Heap summaries did not report Detached* constructors among top retained constructors; object and closure populations did not grow across the pair.

principleOutcomes.reason: All checks were judged contextual and not applicable to the representative public weather/content journeys.

paths.description: Homepage and current-location weather summary; represents entry, location search, navigation, consent, and forecast discovery.
Moscow weather detail; represents the primary forecast task and repeated consent interaction.
Health news article; represents the long-form content template.
Weather maps; represents the interactive map/media template.
Deliberately invalid URL; represents HTTP failure and recovery state.

findings.summary: Consent dialog is unusable at a 360px viewport
findings.evidence: Mobile screenshots on all four representative templates show a fixed 512px consent dialog beginning at x=249; its text and action buttons extend beyond the right viewport edge and cannot be reached.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the dialog inline-size responsive (max-inline-size: min(100% - 2rem, 32rem)), keep all actions inside the viewport, and test at 320–360px.

findings.summary: Consent interstitial blocks the core weather and reading tasks
findings.evidence: Load screenshots show a modal dimming and obscuring the entire forecast/article/map before interaction; on mobile its rejection action is off-screen.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not gate core content behind a full-page tracking dialog. Use a compact, responsive, semantic dialog with immediate equal accept/reject actions and preserve access to essential content.

findings.summary: Primary flow cannot be completed reliably on mobile
findings.evidence: The homepage, weather detail, news article, and map journey all stop at the same horizontally clipped consent state at 360x800.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix the consent step first, then replay location search → forecast, article reading, and map controls end-to-end at mobile widths.

findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark colour-scheme preference
findings.evidence: The prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshot remains the same light grey/white palette as the normal capture; no site dark theme is applied.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and define dark surface, text, border, icon, chart, map, and consent-dialog tokens behind prefers-color-scheme.

findings.summary: Navigation changes are abrupt and do not use View Transitions
findings.evidence: DOM/script inspection found no authored view-transition CSS or transition setup across the MPA links, while representative navigation is cross-document.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } for same-origin pages and stable view-transition-name values for shared header and forecast elements, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Components rely on viewport layout rather than container responsiveness
findings.evidence: The CSS probe over loaded stylesheets found no @container rules; the fixed-width consent component overflows narrow reuse conditions.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable cards/dialogs container-type and use size/style queries for local adaptation rather than fixed desktop dimensions.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and touch-target support are inadequate
findings.evidence: The focus probe focused the Новости link but computed outline-style was none; many primary links were only 20px high and forecast tabs 40px high, below a comfortable 44px target.
findings.suggestedFix: Use :focus-visible with a high-contrast outline and expand interactive hit areas to at least 44x44 CSS px without shrinking visible spacing.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint is extremely slow across every template
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP of 10.8s home, 16.2s weather, 12.2s news, and 12.7s maps; trace LCP was 9.12s.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the LCP element, prioritise its request, reduce server/consent delay, and remove advertising work from the critical path.

findings.summary: Advertising and unused JavaScript dominate delivery and main-thread work
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 2.71MB across 146 requests, 2.22MB of script, with 143 requests and 2.65MB classified third-party; Lighthouse estimated 1,624KiB unused JS on home and 1,612KiB on weather.
findings.suggestedFix: Load bidding, analytics, and maps only after consent and intent; remove duplicate ad loaders, split route bundles, and enforce per-template JS budgets.

findings.summary: Text and controls fail colour contrast across all templates
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 34 contrast failures on home, 32 weather, 19 news, and 39 maps.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace low-contrast text/control tokens with pairs meeting WCAG AA, including disabled-looking forecast labels and consent content.

findings.summary: ARIA structure and map control names are invalid
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 21/16/11/15 required-parent ARIA failures across the templates and five unnamed buttons on maps.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native lists/menus/buttons where possible; otherwise repair required role ownership and provide each map playback control an accessible name.

findings.summary: The 404 recovery page overflows on mobile
findings.evidence: The 360x800 404 screenshot clips the recovery sentence and link off the right edge, although the DOM contains a home link.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a fluid error-state container, wrap the message, keep the home recovery link visible, and retain a clear heading.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie attributes are weak
findings.evidence: Headers evidence found no CSP, frame protection, or Permissions-Policy. Cookie evidence found eight cookies flagged insecure; FCCDCF is non-Secure, SameSite=None, and 390 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive nonce/hash CSP with frame-ancestors, Permissions-Policy and nosniff; mark HTTPS cookies Secure and choose Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is essential.

findings.summary: The page activates a very large tracking and advertising surface
findings.evidence: Tracker capture saw 23 third-party origins; HAR attributed 143 of 146 requests and 2.65MB to third parties, including DoubleClick and Yandex analytics/ad traffic.
findings.suggestedFix: Default to essential requests only before consent, reduce vendors, batch minimal analytics, and publish/enforce a vendor and data-retention budget.

findings.summary: Browser-platform hygiene is degraded
findings.evidence: Every Lighthouse run found a deprecated API warning, five BFCache failure reasons, and DevTools inspector issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the deprecated API use, resolve unload/cache-control/frame BFCache blockers, and clear the inspector issue before release.

findings.summary: App-like weather experience has no offline runtime
findings.evidence: The site links a web app manifest, but navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations() returned no registrations.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a scoped service worker with an offline shell/fallback for saved locations and last-known forecasts, while clearly marking stale data.

findings.summary: Image delivery omits responsive and lazy-loading hints
findings.evidence: Images evidence found five of five images without srcset, four below-fold map thumbnails without loading=lazy, and one image without dimensions; maps Lighthouse found two low-resolution images.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide width/height, responsive srcset/sizes, lazy-load below-fold thumbnails, and serve map imagery at an appropriate device-pixel ratio.

findings.summary: Third-party code and media cost is disproportionate to weather content
findings.evidence: Third-party transfers were 2.65MB of 2.71MB total, led by a 488KB prebid script and multiple advertising stacks, while first-party content was a small fraction.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget, defer nonessential vendors until consent and intent, and remove vendors that do not deliver measurable user value.

findings.summary: Initial memory footprint is disproportionate
findings.evidence: The weather-detail baseline heap summary contained 938,696 nodes and 49,952,936 bytes self size before a representative interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce third-party runtimes and hidden consent-vendor DOM, virtualise long lists, and set heap/DOM budgets for the weather template.

findings.summary: Entity pages lack structured data
findings.evidence: Metadata probe found useful Open Graph tags and hreflang, but no JSON-LD on the weather homepage despite representing places and forecasts.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org WebSite/Organization and applicable Place/WebPage JSON-LD matching visible content; retain current Open Graph tags.

taskList.title: Make consent responsive, non-blocking, semantic, and equally dismissible
Cut third-party and unused JavaScript from the critical path
Repair contrast, ARIA ownership, control names, focus, and targets
Harden CSP, browser policies, and cookie attributes
Fix platform hygiene and BFCache blockers
Add responsive image delivery and budgets
Add offline fallback and stale forecast state
Add View Transitions and component queries
